This Starlog Magazine piece is understood, from its title and byline, to record Dick's own commentary on the Blade Runner film adaptation of Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?, made in the period shortly before his death in March 1982. Dick's attitude toward the production is widely documented elsewhere as having shifted from early wariness -- rooted in his negative reaction to an earlier screenplay draft he found unfaithful to the novel's themes -- to enthusiasm after he was shown early special-effects test footage in late 1981, which he praised for its visual realization of the novel's world. Without a recoverable text for this specific piece, its exact content, tone, and claims cannot be verified from this corpus and should not be treated as established.

**Why it matters.** If recovered, this piece would be a valuable primary-source data point for Dick's own late-life reaction to the film adaptation of his most famous novel, made in the final months before his death.
